definitions.explanation: To fail to get on a train, bus, plane, or other vehicle in time, usually arriving after it has departed.

definitions.gloss: to miss out on, to be left behind
definitions.explanation: To fail to take advantage of an opportunity or trend (figurative use).

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}の{電車|でんしゃ}に{乗|の}り{遅|おく}れてしまった。
{寝坊|ねぼう}して{飛行機|ひこうき}に{乗|の}り{遅|おく}れた。
examples.english: I overslept and missed my flight.

examples.japanese: {時代|じだい}の{流|なが}れに{乗|の}り{遅|おく}れないようにしたい。
examples.english: I don't want to be left behind by the times.
examples.notes: [Note: Figurative use meaning to miss out on trends or changes]

notes:
{乗|の}り{遅|おく}れる is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}) meaning to miss transportation.

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
- {乗|の}る (to ride) + {遅|おく}れる (to be late) → to be late for riding

ASPECT (ている):
{乗|の}り{遅|おく}れている is less common; the simple past {乗|の}り{遅|おく}れた is typically used.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {電車|でんしゃ}に{乗|の}り{遅|おく}れる (miss a train)
- バスに{乗|の}り{遅|おく}れる (miss a bus)
- {飛行機|ひこうき}に{乗|の}り{遅|おく}れる (miss a flight)
- {流行|りゅうこう}に{乗|の}り{遅|おく}れる (miss out on a trend)

SIMILAR EXPRESSION:
- {乗|の}り{損|そこ}なう: also means to miss (transportation), slightly more casual

[Register: Neutral]
